primitives.name: Air Density Correction
primitives.verbatim_quote: AIR: venue air density 1.1245 kg/m3 measured at Mercedes-Benz Stadium [docs/data-sources/research/2026-10-13/weather-pilot/weather-stadium-pilot.json] -> ball carries measurably differently than a sea-level-standard model assumes ; wind 9.7 km/h qualifies it -> deep-ball and kick distances shift; totals and long-DK props carry the effect, spreads barely 2.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\rho_{std}': 'Sea-level standard air density (1.225 kg/m³)', '\\rho_{obs}': 'Observed venue air density (1.1245 kg/m³)', '$\\Delta d$': 'Distance correction factor for ballistics'}
primitives.assumptions: Spherical projectile motion under constant gravity, quadratic drag scaling, negligible Coriolis effect.
primitives.breakdown_regime: High-altitude venues (>1000 m) or extreme temperature deviations where $\rho_{obs}$ departs significantly from 1.225 kg/m³.
